strings.d1.s0.name: The Bund
strings.d1.s0.tips: A row of colonial buildings with Pudong across the river; tai chi practitioners in the morning, no crowds.
strings.d1.s1.name: Nanjing Road East
strings.d1.s1.tips: China's busiest pedestrian street; visit the Shanghai First Food Store.
strings.d1.s2.name: People's Square & Shanghai Museum
strings.d1.s2.tips: Bronze and porcelain collections; free, but you need to reserve with your passport.
strings.d1.s3.name: Yang's Fry Dumplings
strings.d1.s3.tips: Shengjianbao (pan-fried soup dumplings); on Huanghe Road, bite and suck the soup.
strings.d1.s4.name: Bund Night View
strings.d1.s4.tips: Pudong lights 19:00-22:00; a Huangpu River cruise (~120 CNY) is optional.
strings.d1.b0.name: Jia Jia Tang Bao
strings.d1.b0.tips: A xiaolongbao legend; on Huanghe Road, closes early.
strings.d1.b1.name: Huangpu River Cruise
strings.d1.b1.tips: Night river cruise; instead of the Bund.
strings.d2.s0.name: Yu Garden
strings.d2.s0.tips: A classical Ming-dynasty garden; quiet at the 08:30 opening, with a zigzag bridge.
strings.d2.s1.name: Yuyuan Bazaar
strings.d2.s1.tips: A bazaar around the garden; souvenirs and tea.
strings.d2.s2.name: Nanxiang Mantou Dian
strings.d2.s2.tips: The birthplace of xiaolongbao since 1900; upstairs has seating, downstairs has a queue for takeaway.
strings.d2.s3.name: City God Temple
strings.d2.s3.tips: A Taoist temple in the middle of the bazaar.
strings.d2.s4.name: Tianzifang
strings.d2.s4.tips: Studios and cafes in the Shikumen alleys; in the French Concession.
strings.d2.b0.name: Lin Long Fang
strings.d2.b0.tips: Local xiaolongbao; in the French Concession, no tourists.
strings.d2.b1.name: Huxinting Teahouse
strings.d2.b1.tips: A teahouse over the Yu Garden lake.
strings.d3.s0.name: Shanghai Tower Top of Shanghai
strings.d3.s0.tips: 118th floor, 632 m; best on a clear morning, with the world's fastest lift.
strings.d3.s1.name: Lujiazui Pedestrian Bridge
strings.d3.s1.tips: Views of the Oriental Pearl and the towers from the circular bridge.
strings.d3.s2.name: Shanghai Ocean Aquarium
strings.d3.s2.tips: A 155 m underwater tunnel; good with children.
strings.d3.s3.name: Din Tai Fung Pudong
strings.d3.s4.name: Century Park
strings.d3.s4.tips: Pudong's huge park; lake and cycling.
strings.d3.b0.name: Shanghai Grandma Pudong
strings.d3.b0.tips: Local Shanghai cuisine; hongshao rou (red-braised pork).
strings.d3.b1.name: Oriental Pearl Tower
strings.d3.b1.tips: A retro pink tower; instead of Shanghai Tower.
strings.d4.s0.name: Wukang Road
strings.d4.s0.tips: A plane-tree-lined boulevard and Wukang Mansion; Art Deco villas and cafes.
strings.d4.s1.name: Propaganda Poster Art Centre
strings.d4.s1.tips: Mao-era posters in an apartment block basement; hidden and fascinating.
strings.d4.s2.name: Fu 1039
strings.d4.s2.tips: Shanghai cuisine in a 1913 villa; drunken chicken and red-braised pork.
strings.d4.s3.name: Xintiandi
strings.d4.s3.tips: Cafes in restored Shikumen houses; the Museum of the First National Congress of the Communist Party is free.
strings.d4.s4.name: Fuxing Park
strings.d4.s4.tips: A French-style park; retirees dancing and playing mahjong.
strings.d4.b0.name: Jesse Restaurant
strings.d4.b0.tips: The old Jesse; hongshao rou (red-braised pork), reservation needed.
strings.d4.b1.name: Shanghai Museum of Art Pudong
strings.d4.b1.tips: A new museum across from the Bund; instead of Xintiandi.
strings.d5.s0.name: Zhujiajiao Fangsheng Bridge
strings.d5.s0.tips: 1 hour on Metro Line 17; a five-arch bridge from 1571, best before the tour buses arrive in the morning.
strings.d5.s1.name: Zhujiajiao Canal Boat Tour
strings.d5.s1.tips: Gondola ride through the canals; 20 minutes.
strings.d5.s2.name: Kezhi Garden
strings.d5.s2.tips: The town's classical garden; entry with a combined ticket.
strings.d5.s3.name: Zhujiajiao Canalside Restaurant
strings.d5.s3.tips: Zongzi (sticky rice dumplings) and pork trotters; riverside tables.
strings.d5.s4.name: Zhujiajiao Bei Dajie
strings.d5.s4.tips: Shops along North Street; roasted chestnuts.
strings.d5.b0.name: Ah Po Cha Lou Zhujiajiao
strings.d5.b0.tips: A teahouse over the canal; dim sum.
strings.d5.b1.name: Qibao Ancient Town
strings.d5.b1.tips: A water town close to the city; a short alternative to Zhujiajiao.
strings.d6.s0.name: Humble Administrator's Garden
strings.d6.s0.tips: 25 minutes by high-speed train from Hongqiao; China's most famous classical garden, a UNESCO site.
strings.d6.s1.name: Suzhou Museum
strings.d6.s1.tips: I.M. Pei's white-and-grey museum; free, reservation required.
strings.d6.s2.name: Pingjiang Road
strings.d6.s2.tips: An old street along the canal; silk shops and teahouses.
strings.d6.s3.name: Pingjiang Road Noodle House
strings.d6.s4.name: Tiger Hill
strings.d6.s4.tips: A leaning pagoda and the tomb of the King of Wu; return train at 18:00.
strings.d6.b0.name: Songhelou Suzhou
strings.d6.b1.name: Shantang Street
strings.d6.b1.tips: A canal street; instead of Tiger Hill.
strings.d7.s0.name: Jing'an Temple
strings.d7.s0.tips: A gold-roofed temple among skyscrapers; in Jing'an.
strings.d7.s1.name: Jing'an Kerry Centre
strings.d7.s1.tips: A shopping centre; souvenirs and coffee.
strings.d7.s2.name: Xiaoyang Shengjian Jing'an
strings.d7.s2.tips: Shengjianbao (pan-fried soup dumplings); your farewell lunch.
strings.d7.s3.name: Maglev Longyang Road
strings.d7.s3.tips: The maglev reaches Pudong Airport in 8 minutes at 430 km/h; a fitting farewell.
strings.d7.b0.name: Wagas Jing'an
strings.d7.b1.name: Jing'an Sculpture Park
strings.d7.b1.tips: A sculpture park and the Natural History Museum.
strings.note0: Alipay and WeChat Pay work with foreign cards, and cash is rarely used; the metro is cheap and extensive (3-7 CNY). The maglev takes 8 minutes to Pudong.
strings.note1: Visa: in 2026 many countries get 30 days visa-free (check for Türkiye); set up a VPN for Google and WhatsApp in advance.
strings.note2: October to November is best (18-22°C); winter is damp and cold at 5°C, February is closed for Chinese New Year, April brings cherry blossom.
strings.note3: Xiaolongbao costs 30-50 CNY; go to Yang's for shengjianbao; brunch in the French Concession is 100+.
strings.note4: Museums are free, but you need to reserve online with your passport; buy your Shanghai Tower ticket online.
strings.note5: No tipping; bargaining works in markets, not in shops.
strings.transit.name: Shanghai Public Transportation Card / Alipay
strings.transit.why_chosen: For metro and buses; the Alipay Transport code also works with foreign cards
